descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule
The IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing technical support to local users a primary responsibility, but also globally as needed and time allows. The IT specialist must balance hands-on assistance at a manufacturing site with broader service desk duties. This role ensures efficient IT service delivery and system support, contributing to both user satisfaction and system reliability.
 Key Roles & Responsibilities: 
 Service Delivery & User Support 
Establish and maintain strong IT service relationships by providing timely and effective support to end-users across the company.
Perform hands-on support for local hardware, software, and production systems, ensuring system uptime and manufacturing connectivity.
Deliver high-quality IT services according to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), ensuring incidents and requests are resolved efficiently.
Apply Incident, Problem, and Change Management principles for effective service operations.
Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support, and coordinate with Tier 3 when needed, ensuring issues are escalated and resolved appropriately.
 Local & Global IT Support 
Provide desktop and laptop support, including hardware setup, software configuration, and troubleshooting for both local and remote users.
Manage the deployment and refresh of IT hardware, ensuring all devices meet corporate standards.
Support printer and multifunction device installation, configuration, and maintenance.
Work as the global service desk to resolve IT issues via phone, email, and chat for worldwide users, ensuring global service requests are handled efficiently.
Provide support for mobile devices, office phones, and basic network issues such as connectivity and VPN access.
 Project & Network Support 
Collaborate on IT infrastructure projects, such as hardware upgrades, software rollouts, and cloud migrations, ensuring local and global project goals are met.
Assist in maintaining local network infrastructure, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and ensuring user devices comply with corporate security policies.
Support IT initiatives by helping enforce data security, backup protocols, and compliance standards across systems.
Act as a “smart hand” for remote teams, assisting with physical tasks such as equipment racking and server reboots.
 Key Competencies: 
 Technical Expertise: Knowledge of hardware (PCs, printers, mobile devices) and common software applications. Familiarity with troubleshooting MS windows and resolving user issues related to applications.
 Problem Solving: Quick diagnostic skills with a focus on resolving user and system issues effectively and efficiently.
 Communication: Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical users, ensuring smooth communication and problem resolution.
 Collaboration: Work effectively across teams and departments, coordinating with local and global IT staff to resolve issues and implement solutions.
 Organization & Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
 Education 
Associate's degree, Technical Diploma, or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. 
Equivalent qualifications such as a Higher National Diploma (HND), Advanced Diploma, or completion of a recognized technical apprenticeship are also accepted.
 Experience 
1-2 years of experience in IT support
 Recent technical school graduates also considered
Experience with service desk ticketing systems (e.g., SolarWinds, ServiceNow, JIRA) and remote support tools.
Experience working with Microsoft Windows OS, Microsoft Office Suite, and various PC hardware.
